correctness.rationale: PASS: The source gives the exact normalized geometric-vector inner product; independent SymPy differentiation reproduced its degree-eight stationarity polynomial, the nine Möbius-transformed coefficients and the h_j differences. The sign-chain inequalities c4-4c3<0,5c5-7c4<0,2c6-c5<0 hold for x,v>0 and 0<u<1, with c0,c1,c2>0 and c7,c8<0; Descartes gives exactly one simple interior root of G. The root ρ of h1 is unique since h1_z<0; at ρ, G(ρ)=4(1-ρ)(1-q^4ρ^4)q^3ρ^3(t-τ), determining the optimizer's relative location and the s derivative sign. The h3 root locates z* below it and gives t derivative positive. Differentiating h1 gives ρ'(q)>0; τ=(1-v²)/(2v³), v=qρ, hence strict decrease. Near q=1 the exact cubic-degeneracy relation for δ=1-ρ proves δ~(4/5)^(1/3)(1-q)^(1/3). The q=0 Laurent coefficients follow from ρ=3/5+O(q^4). Independent symbolic and sample root tests corroborate identities; the theorem concerns only the geometric test optimizer, not the Hilbert-space numerical radius.
